bio_en: Zhizhou studied under Huizhao and continued the Faxiang teaching associated with Kuiji. His Explication of the Subtleties explains difficult passages in the commentarial tradition of the Treatise Establishing Consciousness Only. Later accounts recognize him as the third patriarch of the Ci'en lineage.
bio_summary: 智周從慧沼受唯識學，著《成唯識論演祕》，疏通窺基《述記》之義。後世奉為慈恩宗第三祖。
